name: United Nations Security Council
agenda: Maintenance of International Peace and Security: Assessing the Effectiveness, Enforcement and Exit of Sanctions Regimes
overview: The Security Council is responsible for keeping international peace and security. It has 15 members, and five of them (China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom and the United States) can veto a resolution.

eb.name: Akash P Videsh
eb.bio: Akash Videsh is a young science enthusiast and a Computer Science Engineering graduate from VIT Chennai, currently carving his path in the professional world. He began his MUN journey back in 8th grade and has since taken on a range of leadership roles, including Secretary-General, Chief Advisor and Chairperson, at several prominent school and collegiate MUNs. His passion for international affairs continues today, with active participation in college and city-level circuits, especially in dynamic crisis committees where quick thinking is key. He has also served as the President of the Debate Society of VIT Chennai and was a prominent member of the VIT Chennai MUN delegation. A lifelong quizzer, he was a dominant force in the Coimbatore quiz scene throughout high school, leading his school to success in some of the country's most prestigious quiz competitions.

eb.name: Hasini Kasuganti
eb.bio: Hasini Kasuganti is a DP1 student at CHIREC International School, interested in design and economics. She has been an active member of the circuit, attending close to 30 MUNs. She attempts to bring precision and empathy to every conference she attends. Apart from MUNs, you will find her listening to Sade on repeat. She looks forward to meaningful debate in UNSC as the Vice Chair!

name: Disarmament and International Security Committee
agenda: Deliberating Upon Strengthening the Global Nuclear Non-Proliferation Regime in the Face of Emerging Security Challenges
overview: DISEC is the First Committee of the UN General Assembly, where every member country has a seat. It deals with weapons, disarmament and threats to peace between countries.

eb.name: Sanat Puri
eb.bio: Sanat Puri is a pillar of legacy in the MUN circuit with an extraordinary 14-year journey. Having been associated with 160+ conferences across India and abroad, Mr Puri is known for his calm authority and incisive intellect. Sanat doesn't just lead a committee; he elevates it. He ardently advocates for "Winning in Life, not just in MUNs", inspiring delegates to aspire to greatness and uphold virtuous values.

name: United Nations Human Rights Council
agenda: Role of States in Countering the Negative Impact of Disinformation on the Enjoyment and Realization of Human Rights
overview: The Human Rights Council has 47 member countries and meets in Geneva. It looks at human rights problems around the world and what countries should do about them.

eb.name: D Sai Srikar
eb.bio: Srikar has been an active participant in Model UN for over four years. He has dedicated countless weekends to learning through MUN, and he looks forward to another exciting weekend where he can share what he's learned!

eb.name: Vivaan Sharma
eb.bio: Vivaan Sharma is a Grade 11 student, having previously attended Oakridge International School, and currently studying at CHIREC International School, where he is taking Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, along with Finance, a field in which he hopes to pursue a career. With half a decade of Model United Nations experience under his belt, Vivaan has developed a particular interest in UNHRC and UNSC, where diplomacy, debate and international affairs take centre stage. Outside committee, he enjoys playing basketball and can often be found on the court when he isn't occupied with academics or MUN.

name: Lok Sabha (Indian Parliament)
agenda: Discussion on Strengthening India’s Education System through Greater Uniformity in School Education and Comprehensive Reforms in Public Examinations
overview: The Lok Sabha is the lower house of India's Parliament, with 543 elected members. Here delegates represent members of parliament and their parties instead of countries.

eb.name: Manan Garg
eb.bio: Manan Garg, yes, the one common name when we talk about Indian committees in Hyderabad, is an experienced MUN enthusiast who has always been renowned for his dominance and fiery speeches in Indian committees. At present a CA aspirant, his experience in Model United Nations has been extensive, with 35+ conferences. When he doesn't have his head buried in the lively chaos of Lok Sabha debates, he is seen playing box cricket with friends or satiating his appetite for rerunning Marvel movies and series. Apart from Indian committees, you can also see him chairing cricket-oriented simulations and Marvel or film-oriented simulations, and he was on the EB of the first ever IFI simulation in the Hyderabad MUN circuit. He has also served as the Chief Advisor to several successful MUN conferences, contributing to their overall execution and overseeing end-to-end financial management. You must have delegated with him, and chances are you've either rallied behind his lobby... or watched your bloc crumble against it. He believes the best way to win is to lead and dominate. His committees are known for integrating both the fun and technical aspects, making the committee exciting as well as productive. He looks forward to seeing you all in the committee.

name: World Health Organization
agenda: Addressing Mental Health and Addiction Among Young People
overview: The World Health Organization is the UN agency for health. It works on disease outbreaks, vaccines and helping countries build better health systems.

eb.name: Syed Hudaifah
eb.bio: With nearly a decade in MUNs and over 100 conferences under his belt, Hudaifah is a quantum physicist and a passionate food connoisseur. Returning to Oakridge is always a special experience, and he looks forward to being a part of OakJMUN 2026!

eb.name: Pratheek Konda
eb.bio: Pratheek Konda is an aspiring doctor and an IBDP 1 student at Oakridge International School, taking Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics at Higher Level. He loves Barca with his whole heart and plays football for his school. He would love to see each and every one of you at OakJMUN 2026.

eb.name: Archith Ragi
eb.bio: Archith Ragi is a DP1 student with a keen interest in finance, economics and entrepreneurship, and takes Mathematics AA, Economics and Physics at Higher Level. He is curious about financial markets, business strategy and the role of economics in shaping the world. Beyond academics, he is a committed vegan and passionate about animal liberation.

name: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
agenda: Strengthening Border Control Mechanisms to Prevent the Smuggling of Illicit Drugs
overview: UNODC helps countries deal with illegal drugs, organised crime and corruption. It is based in Vienna.

eb.name: Aripra Sharma
eb.bio: whirlwind (n): a rush of chaos and momentum. Take your pick on whether that's a connotation of the word itself or a personal biography. Aripra is an IBDP1 student at CHIREC and she's a mix of B99 reruns and blasts of Green Day and Drake, paired with the desire to live by the words "I go to seek a great perhaps." What keeps her coming back to MUNs is the chance to take all that chaos and put it towards something meaningful. As Vice Chair, she hopes to see this committee become a whirlwind of its own: delegates listening, building on ideas and speaking up, nerves and all.

eb.name: Satvik Amula
eb.bio: Satvik Amula is a DP1 student currently studying at CHIREC International School, with intentions of studying biochemical sciences and a passion for research. He intends to pursue medicine in the future. Having performed in multiple conferences, he finds MUNs a spectacular platform for innovative ideas, debating, improving public speaking, research and learning how the world functions. In his free time, he loves to read and binge-watch sitcoms, and loves basketball (although his skills may be questionable). As Rapporteur, he aims to make the committee just as invigorating, exciting and enjoyable as it is educational for all delegates, to the best of his ability.

name: United Nations Commission on the Status of Women
agenda: Protecting Women’s Freedom of Expression while Combating Online Incitement, Harassment and Gender-Based Abuse
overview: The Commission on the Status of Women is the main UN body working for gender equality and the rights of women and girls. It has 45 member countries and meets every March in New York.

eb.name: Rishika Agrawal
eb.bio: Rishika Agrawal is a first-year BBA student at TAPMI, Manipal. Having participated in over 40 MUNs, she has developed a love for meeting new people, exchanging ideas and exploring different perspectives. She is particularly interested in marketing, branding and social media, especially the creative side of how brands connect with people. Outside academics, dance has always been a passion of hers. She enjoys trying new things, taking on new opportunities and learning along the way.

eb.name: Anahita Nair
eb.bio: Anahita Nair is a DP2 student studying Maths, Economics and Psychology at Higher Level. Having been part of the MUN circuit for four years across the Executive Board, delegating and International Press, she's excited for JMUN and looks forward to meeting all the delegates and making this conference a memorable experience!

name: United Nations Children's Fund
agenda: Safeguarding the Rights of the Child in the Digital Age, with Special Emphasis on Minimum Age Standards for Social Media and Platform Accountability
overview: UNICEF works for children's rights in more than 190 countries and territories. It focuses on children's health, education and safety.

eb.name: Naga Pranay Immadi
eb.bio: Pranay is an IBDP student at Oakridge with a strong interest in technology, entrepreneurship and public speaking. He's currently working on Proteus Arc, a healthcare organisation focused on making algorithms to make Alzheimer's diagnosis more accessible. He enjoys exploring new ideas and questioning how things are usually done. Pranay believes MUN is about the people, the experiences and everything you learn along the way. As Vice Chair of UNICEF, he hopes to make the committee a place where delegates can genuinely enjoy themselves, be active debaters and walk away with a memorable experience, guided by a belief he strongly resonates with: "A great debate doesn't end when someone wins. It ends when everyone leaves thinking differently."

eb.name: Arjun Bringi
eb.bio: Arjun Bringi, a 10th grader at Oakridge International School, is an enthusiastic MUNer with over 15 conferences under his belt. Apart from MUNs, Arjun is an aspiring entrepreneur, an avid writer and a passionate runner aiming to break his own 42-minute 10k. He's excited to be a part of OakJMUN 2026 and looks forward to serving as the Rapporteur for UNICEF.

name: Futuristic Crisis Committee
agenda: The Nuclear Run: A Race Against Time to Stop Global Nuclear War (freeze date: 4 July 2050)
overview: The Futuristic Crisis Committee is set in the future. Instead of debating one fixed agenda, delegates respond to news from the crisis team as it arrives, and every decision they make changes what happens next. The scenario is announced with the agenda.

eb.name: Dhanush Malhotra
eb.bio: Dhanush Malhotra is a law student at ICFAI, Hyderabad. Law school has guided him to recover his lost interest in debates, BPDs, APDs, MUNs, politics, international policies and the joy of a good argument. A growing name in the MUN circuit, having served on the Executive Board at more than 40 conferences, he looks forward to great debate, meaningful discussions and creative strategies. In his free time, Dhanush enjoys listening to music, reading, and watching movies and TV shows.

name: Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space
agenda: Spin-off Benefits of Space Technology: Review of Current Status (Agenda item 10)
overview: COPUOS was set up by the UN General Assembly in 1959 to look after the peaceful use and exploration of outer space. It has more than 100 member countries and meets in Vienna.

eb.name: Shrey Vajpayee
eb.bio: Shrey is an IBDP 2 student at Oakridge International School, eyeing a career in finance. He has a deep interest in global politics, and wholeheartedly looks forward to another productive weekend of Model UN.

eb.name: Harini Reddy
eb.bio: Harini Reddy is an IBDP 2 student at Oakridge Gachibowli, balancing Business Management, Economics and Maths AI at Higher Level. She hopes to study quantitative finance and build a career in the field. Though she has always been a little shy of public speaking, guiding the participants of a Junior Model United Nations conference remains one of her favourite pursuits, and a role she approaches with great responsibility and excitement. She is thrilled to serve as your Vice Chair in COPUOS!

name: Avengers: Doomsday
agenda: Preventing Incursions: Safeguarding the Sacred Timeline Against Total Multiversal Collapse
overview: Doomsday takes its story from Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday. Delegates face a threat to the whole world and have to decide, together, how to stop it. The full scenario is announced with the agenda.

eb.name: Kingshuk Maulik
eb.bio: Kingshuk is currently pursuing a Master's degree in Food Science and Technology after graduating with First Class Distinction in BSc (Hons) with Research in Food Science and Technology from GITAM (Deemed to be University), Hyderabad. Having chaired over 15 Model United Nations committees, he brings strong analytical, organisational and research skills, alongside a keen interest in diplomacy and public discourse. As the Founder and Former President of GMUN Hyderabad, he has worked to create inclusive, innovative and collaborative platforms that foster meaningful engagement and critical thinking. Guided by the principle that "with great power comes great responsibility", he strives to ensure every delegate is heard, challenged and empowered to contribute.

eb.name: Aryan Panda
eb.bio: Aryan Panda, an IBDP1 student at CHIREC International School, has honed his leadership, communication and community service skills through seven years of active participation in Model United Nations conferences. A keen STEM enthusiast and electronics hobbyist, he serves as President of his school's STEM Club, where he leads hands-on sessions to make science accessible to younger students. He also writes on sustainability for Re-Cycl and hopes to pursue aerospace engineering. As the Founder of Mission Sahayata, he has demonstrated a deep commitment to community upliftment, organising initiatives to support those in need. Aryan's passion for community service, adaptability and proactive nature, coupled with his strong organisational and time management skills, make him a valuable asset. His continuous pursuit of personal development ensures his ongoing excellence and readiness to contribute meaningfully to any team or project.

eb.name: Shaurya Poduvu
eb.bio: Shaurya Poduvu is a DP1 student at Oakridge, taking Maths, Economics and Business Management at Higher Level. His game plan is to score well, have fun and get into a great college. Aside from procrastinating on studying, he's a big fan of movies and TV shows, and loves to get into a good discussion on the topic. When he's not watching movies, you'll find him playing video games with friends, listening to music or reading a book. He also has an avid interest in all things superhero universes and comic lore, including Marvel Comics and the MCU.

name: International Press
overview: International Press delegates are the conference's journalists and photographers. Instead of debating, they report on the committees, write articles and take photos.

team.name: Anisha Karjela
team.bio: Anisha Karjela is a DP2 student studying Maths, Psychology and Economics at Higher Level. Having taken part in many MUNs as part of the IP, she enjoys showcasing the energy and essence of conferences through photography. In her free time, you'll probably find her taking a long nap or rewatching her favourite shows. As Co-Director of Photography, Anisha is excited to help lead the photographers in documenting every memorable moment of JMUN!

team.name: Tanisi Reddy Allola
team.bio: Tanisi Reddy Allola is a DP1 student at Oakridge International School studying Mathematics, Economics and Business at Higher Level. Having participated in many MUNs as part of the International Press, she has developed a keen eye for capturing the essence of every conference through photography. Beyond the lens, she loves travelling and is always up for a spontaneous plan, finding inspiration in the people and experiences around her. With her creativity, attention to detail and passion for visual storytelling, Tanisi is excited to bring every moment of JMUN to life as Co-Director of Photography.
